covered_report_window.plain_language: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Monday, September 14, 2026 market close and before the Tuesday, September 15, 2026 market open

report_type: US1 immediate earnings window consensus report
market_context_summary: The 10-year Treasury yield touched 5% as oil and inflation concerns intensified immediately before the September 15-16 FOMC meeting. Broad equities were roughly flat while QQQ lagged and small caps held up, increasing valuation and financing sensitivity for event-driven names.

methodology.disparity_definition: Rounded 0-100 composite: one-half the mean pairwise direction-score difference after normalizing the -100 to +100 scale, plus one-half the mean pairwise reversal-risk difference. Lower means tighter agreement.
methodology.learned_lessons_review: No new method change. Existing key-metric, priced-in, low-bar reversal, timing-confirmation, and same-day headline checks were applied.

top_setups.note: Only two names produced consensus downside calls; no third downward setup met the evidence threshold.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record bookings, a 2.3x book-to-bill and $1.98B backlog favor upside if order conversion and the fiscal 2027 outlook clear a now-de-risked bar.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Roughly $434.2M revenue and $0.24 EPS; options imply about +/-15.7%, versus a limited two-event realized average near 7.2%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Bookings stay elevated, Q4 lands near or above prior guidance, margins expand, and FY2027 demand visibility remains strong.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Book-to-bill normalizes, capacity absorption or working capital disappoints, or secondary-share supply caps enthusiasm.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Event pricing is unusually wide; the stock was down about 8% intraday and roughly 46% over three months, reducing but not eliminating execution risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Management raised FY2026 guidance last quarter; sell-side consensus remains broadly bullish, but reliable fresh revision breadth is limited.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Preannouncement priced in; weak cash conversion
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Preannounced record revenue, gross profit and adjusted EBITDA above the prior analyst range support upside, provided free cash flow and German margins validate the headline growth.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Company guidance is C$195M-C$200M revenue, C$51M-C$53.5M gross profit and C$15.2M-C$16.5M adjusted EBITDA, all above the FactSet range cited at preannouncement.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Results reach the upper half of guidance, Remexian margins improve, Canadian same-store sales stabilize, and cash conversion is positive.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: The preannouncement leaves little surprise, adjusted results outpace cash flow, or German distribution margins weaken.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No dependable liquid event-implied move was located; short interest was reported below 1% of float, limiting squeeze leverage.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Published Q3 consensus around C$191.7M revenue and C$0.01 EPS trailed the later company revenue range; analyst coverage remains thin.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Fast ASSURE adoption and gross-margin expansion support a modest upside edge, but a higher loss estimate and recent share-price strength make guidance quality decisive.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $29.0M-$29.6M revenue and a $0.61-$0.63 loss per share; three-month revenue estimates rose about 3.5%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Prescription growth sustains another revenue beat, gross margin stays above 50%, and $137M FY2027 revenue guidance is reaffirmed or raised.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Sales-force spending widens losses, prescription growth slows, or management leaves the annual guide unchanged after a strong prior quarter.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable liquid event-implied move was located; the stock traded around $23.57, up about 3% intraday, raising some sell-the-news exposure.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Revenue expectations moved higher while near-term EPS estimates softened; recent BTIG and JPMorgan actions were constructive.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Very low bar; turnaround relief squeeze
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The burden is on comparable sales to improve materially from the Q1 decline and early-Q2 weakness, while a CEO transition and downward estimates keep the base case tilted lower.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $557M-$561M revenue and $0.18-$0.19 adjusted EPS; the 30-day EPS consensus was flat after a substantial earlier reset.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Comps inflect toward positive, remodels and promotions show durable traffic gains, and the company holds its $100M-plus free-cash-flow target.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Comps remain negative, EBITDA quality deteriorates, or new leadership gives weak visibility despite an acceptable reported quarter.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply roughly +/-18.2%, above the cited 10-year average near 13.3%; the roughly $8 stock already embeds distress and can squeeze on modest relief.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q2 EPS expectations fell materially from roughly $0.33 ninety days earlier; consensus ratings are mostly Hold.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Flat revenue and a 240-basis-point Q3 EBITDA-margin decline create a mild downside bias, but acquisitions, low leverage and volatile freight conditions weaken the edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Sparse estimates center near $231M-$236M revenue and $0.06-$0.09 EPS; coverage breadth is limited.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Adjusted gross profit rebounds, recent acquisitions contribute cleanly, buybacks continue, and freight disruption supports pricing.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Margin remains depressed, integration costs rise, or shipment volumes soften despite firmer selected lane rates.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: One source indicated about +/-9.5% implied, close to its cited historical move; volume and analyst coverage are comparatively thin.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Four analysts split between Buy and Hold in one current compilation; current-quarter revision breadth is not robust.
